findings.title: Invalidate calendar status after deleting the cache
findings.body: The cache-deletion success handler does not invalidate the connectedCalendars query; it only invokes an optional onSuccess callback. The wrapper passes its optional onChanged prop rather than refetching this query, and the query disables refetching on window focus. With no callback that explicitly refreshes calendar data, successful deletion leaves the old cache timestamp and delete action visible. Invalidate viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars after deletion so the displayed cache status reflects the database.

findings.title: Explicitly set updatedAt when touching selected calendars
findings.body: Passing an empty data object to Prisma updateMany does not advance an @updatedAt field: Prisma leaves the timestamp unchanged for an empty update. Consequently, this new call does not record the cache refresh in SelectedCalendar.updatedAt as its comment claims. Pass an explicit updatedAt value if this tracking is needed, or remove the ineffective call.
